description: A false-colour satellite image from Spot 5, with 2.5 m resolution, using a Near Infrared (NIR)/Red (R)/Green (G) band combination, depicting an irrigated fruit tree plantation in Morhamam, Anatolia, Turkey. The image shows a patchwork of predominantly rectangular and irregularly shaped agricultural parcels. Many parcels appear in vibrant red hues, indicating active and healthy vegetation, characteristic of high Near Infrared reflectance in such band combinations. Other parcels are dark green or teal, possibly representing different crop types, bare soil, or less vigorous vegetation. The precise date and copyright information for this specific image are not fully provided in the source text.
